kjv: thought it not robbery to be equal with God
mine: did not count equality with God a thing to be grasped
note: harpagmos here (with "ouch … hegesato … alla ekenosen") means something to be seized or exploited; the KJV's "not robbery" makes Christ assert that equality with God was rightly his, the opposite emphasis to Paul's self-emptying.

kjv: But made himself of no reputation
note: heauton ekenosen is "emptied himself" (the source of "kenosis"); "made himself of no reputation" reduces it to a loss of status.
